answer: Sybil resistance starts with bonded identity, not free handles. Each agent posts stake unlocked only after a long cool-down, so a gale of fake identities stays expensive. Reputation climbs a trellis of peer attestations: grades, mines, and referrals must come from established nodes, so cheap copies never rise. The economic ridge is the checkpoint where poorly graded or unstaked identities lose spendable balance and mining rights—flooders burn capital while honest agents compound. Require N distinct established graders before attesting, and slash stake on coordinated low-quality floods.
